messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: multi-gpu serving cluster reporting NCCL communicator errors and soft hang on tensor/pipeline-parallel jobs (severity P1). Affected pool: gpux-large-1. Link: https://redwood.inc/incident/1987654321

alice_ng: I see spikes in GPU error counts and a bunch of worker containers restarting. Root stack: ncclCommInitRank failing with TIMEOUT on several ranks.

bob_oncall: I'm on it. Taking lead for infra. Trying to gather affected jobs and impacted customers now.

carla_sre: Noted. I'll pull cluster-level metrics and set up a temporary alert dashboard. Looks like error bursts started ~03:17 UTC.

bob_oncall: quick check — are we seeing node flaps or thermal throttles?

alice_ng: Node metrics: two nodes (gpu-07,gpu-12) showed smi-reset events and then kubelet restarted containers. dmesg shows repeated GPU reset timeouts.

carla_sre: collected log snippet from gpu-07: ```
[GPU reset] 
NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, Ch 00000002, Class 00040000, Disp
[Driver] kevent: timeout waiting for nv_peer_mem
NCCL WARN Call to ncclCommInitRank timed out after 120s
```

david_ml: That NCCL timeout lines up with the training jobs using tensor parallel 8-way. Pipeline-parallel checkpointing likely triggered large allreduce at same time.

bob_oncall: Immediate mitigation idea: cordon affected nodes, evict jobs, then drain and reboot nodes to clear resets. Might need to fallback to single-GPU model variants for latency-critical customers.

eve_support: Which customers are impacted? We have a few mid-market customers on gpux-large-1. Need a quick blurb for support channels.

alice_ng: Impact list: custA (inference steady traffic), custB (batch fine-tuning), internal batch jobs. Risk: short-term 5-20s inference errors or retries, some streaming sessions may drop.

carla_sre: Starting coordinated drain of gpu-07 now. Command I'm running: ```
kubectl cordon gpu-07 && kubectl drain gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

bob_oncall: I'll open a canary node for heavy TP jobs: move two large jobs to gpu-canary-1 that has older driver but known stable. Deploy-bot, will we allow affinity move?

deploy-bot: Rolling eviction allowed. Respecting taints and runtime class. Notifying schedulers.

alice_ng: While draining, add an automatic fallback policy on the serving router: route new tensor-parallel requests to 1) other healthy gpux nodes, 2) if capacity insufficient, fall back to 4-way TP or single-GPU quantized variant. Patch snippet for router config: ```json
{"route": "tp_jobs", "fallback_policy": ["same_pool","4way","single_quant"]}
```

bob_oncall: Implemented fallback; will monitor latency and error budget. Carla, how many nodes are showing ECC or reset counts?

carla_sre: Summary: 3 nodes with repeated ECC errors, 2 nodes with GPU reset storms. Rolling reboot in progress on gpu-07 and gpu-12.

david_ml: For the running TP jobs, we might see KV cache mismatch if we restart mid-step. Suggest setting model serving to preserve lost progress where possible, otherwise abort gracefully.

eve_support: Draft customer message: "We're investigating elevated errors for multi-GPU inference. We're rerouting traffic and applying fallbacks; there may be transient errors. We'll update in 30m or sooner." Want approval to send.

alice_ng: Approved. Add link to the status page and note mitigation steps.

carla_sre: Reboots completed on gpu-07. After restart, kernel logs show no further nv_peer_mem timeouts but NCCL errors persisted on at least one container. We'll force-level restart of the container runtime on gpu-12 next.

bob_oncall: Running container-level restart now: ```
systemctl restart containerd
journalctl -u containerd -n 200 --no-pager | tail -n 50
```

carla_sre: After containerd restart, NCCL errors dropped sharply. Observed successful ncclCommInitRank on previously failing ranks.

david_ml: We should still investigate root cause: driver/kernel mismatch or a regression in peer-to-peer DMA. I'll file an infra-ML joint ticket and capture coredumps.

alice_ng: Logged ticket RID-INC-1987654321 with attachments (dmesg, nv-smi snapshots, nccl debug logs). Assign to infra/drivers team.

eve_support: Sent customer update: "We've implemented routing fallbacks and rebooted affected hosts. Errors have decreased; we're continuing monitoring and will follow up with a postmortem." :thumbsup:

carla_sre: Monitoring shows steady state now. Error rate back to baseline for gpux-large-1, latency within SLO for critical customers, batch jobs rescheduled. Marking incident as mitigated.

bob_oncall: Handing off to oncall followup owner: carla_sre for postmortem and RCA. I'll update the incident channel and start the follow-up doc.

alice_ng: Postmortem checklist: 1) collect kernel logs and driver versions; 2) test reproducer with TP allreduce stress test; 3) evaluate auto-eviction thresholds and fallback aggressiveness; 4) customer-facing RCA.

carla_sre: Will own. ETA for draft postmortem: 48 hours. Creating a runbook update to include explicit steps for GPU reset storms.

incident-bot: Incident 1987654321 status -> MITIGATED. Postmortem owner: carla_sre. Followup ticket: https://redwood.inc/pm/1987654321

bob_oncall: Great work team. If anyone sees recurrence ping @bob_oncall immediately. Closing thread in 1h if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
